title: The Gone Flag
scene: At 9:15 AM, the school flag vanished. The grounds were locked during the ceremony from 9:00 to 9:30.

suspects.name: Iris Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the assembly at 9:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The assembly camera shows Iris at 9:13.

suspects.name: Jonas Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at the flagpole at 9:15, lowering the flag.
suspects.contradiction: The grounds were locked at 9:00, and flag rope was in Jonas's pocket.

suspects.name: Kayla Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the classroom at 9:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The classroom camera shows Kayla at 9:14.

suspects.name: Lionel Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the hall at 9:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The hall camera shows Lionel at 9:12 and 9:20.
